context.transcript:
Hi, everyone, and welcome to Baking Matters, the show
where famous cooks share their delicious recipes with us.
Before we get started with today's program, don't forget
to sign up for our newsletter. You can sign up on our Web
site, and it will be delivered right to your in-box. And now,
for today's show, we have a cake-designing lesson led by
expert baker Heather Silva. Heather has placed first in the
Havenville Baking Competition three years in a row. And,
Just this month, she published her first book, titled
Heather's Cake-Designing Tips. Look for it at your local
bookstore. Now, grab your apron, and let's get baking!
context.transcript_translation: 大家好，欢迎收看《烘焙要事》。在这个节目中，著名厨师会和我们分享他们的美味食谱。在今天的节目开始前，别忘了订阅我们的电子简报。您可以在我们的网站上订阅，简报会直接发送到您的收件箱。现在进入今天的节目：烘焙专家希瑟·席尔瓦将带来一堂蛋糕装饰课。希瑟连续三年在海文维尔烘焙大赛中获得第一名，而且就在本月，她出版了自己的第一本书《希瑟的蛋糕装饰技巧》。请到您当地的书店寻找这本书。现在，穿上围裙，让我们开始烘焙吧！
